notes: "XCU Universe" is a software/firmware license tier (alongside "XCU UXF Enterprise" and "XCU UXF Xpress") applied to the same physical XCU UXF base-station hardware, per Grass Valley's own "XCU UXF Universe / Enterprise / Xpress" release notes (v17-v30, 2021-2024). Grass Valley does not publish a separate spec sheet per license tier; the authoritative connector/electrical spec used here is the manufacturer's "XCU Camera Base Station" datasheet (DS-PUB-3-1041C-EN, dated 2026), which documents the shared XCU UXF hardware platform (referred to there as "XCU Xpress UXF"). Physical I/O should be identical across Xpress/Enterprise/Universe tiers; only enabled features (e.g. full IP, high-speed/4K formats) differ by license. Ports listed reflect the SFP+ (IP-capable) "UXF Cradle" configuration (4x SFP+ in two redundant pairs, Port A1/A2 + Port B1/B2). An alternate factory configuration ("UXF Cradle 12G SDI") swaps those 4 SFP+ cages for 4 additional fixed 1.5G-12G SDI BNC outputs instead — not included here to avoid double-counting; add 4x bnc output ports graded sdi-12g if modeling that variant. Two connector types have no exact match in the allowed id list and were mapped to the closest available option (see per-port notes): the D-sub 15-pin Signaling I/O and Intercom I/O connectors (mapped to "vga"), and the proprietary LEMO hybrid SMPTE ST304 camera fiber/power connector (mapped to "fiber-lc"). Exact physical BNC layout/labeling (e.g. BNC-A/B/C/D/E per firmware release notes) can shift certain outputs between HD-SDI, SD-SDI, or 4K-UHD 2SI/Quad roles depending on the selected video mode; the port list enumerates the datasheet's "HD/3G 1X/3X/6X modes" connector table, the most complete published enumeration. Confidence is medium because this is a shared-hardware datasheet rather than a "Universe"-specific spec sheet, and some SDI grades (sdi-hd/sdi-sd) were inferred from the stated SMPTE standards (ST 292 = HD-SDI, ST 259 = SD-SDI) rather than an explicit bit-rate table per port.
